\title{Certified Coherent-Collar Partition Optimization}
\author{}
\date{21 July 2026}
\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
We optimize the complete finite-time coherent-staple conditional estimate,
including its exact $SU(2)$ Haar denominator and Poisson-image prefactors.  A
unique stationarity equation replaces the earlier unproved numerical-search
optimality.  Re-optimizing the local $K+R$ radius gives a nonempty conditional
coherent-channel budget inside the certified nonlinear window.  Collar
occurrence for the complete measure remains open.
\end{abstract}

Let $v(\delta)$ be normalized Haar mass of an $SU(2)$ geodesic ball.  For
$m$ staples in a common $\eta$-ball, heat time $t$, and target curvature
$\rho$, Stage 15 gives
\[
 \mathbb P\{d(I,VQ_j)\ge\rho\mid\text{coherent collar}\}
 \le \exp L_{t,\rho,\eta}(\delta),
\]
where
\[
 L_{t,\rho,\eta}(\delta)=
 -\log v(\delta)+\log\frac{\rho}{\sin\rho}
 +(m+1)\log c_t
 -\frac{\rho^2-m(\eta+\delta)^2}{2t},
\]
and $0<\delta<\rho/\sqrt m-\eta$.

\begin{theorem}[Unique denominator optimizer]
On every admissible interval containing its stationary point,
$L_{t,\rho,\eta}$ has a unique global interior minimum $\delta_*$, determined
by
\[
 \frac{v'(\delta_*)}{v(\delta_*)}
 =\frac{m(\eta+\delta_*)}{t}.
\]
The optimizer is independent of $\rho$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Differentiation gives
\[
 L'(\delta)=-\frac{v'(\delta)}{v(\delta)}
             +\frac{m(\eta+\delta)}{t}.
\]
The radial density $\sin^2\delta$ is strictly log-concave on the local
interval.  Its primitive $v(\delta)$ is log-concave, so $v'/v$ is decreasing;
the right side of the stationarity equation is strictly increasing.  Near
zero $v'/v\sim3/\delta$, and hence a sign change gives exactly one root.  The
derivative changes from negative to positive there.  Terms containing $\rho$
are constant in $\delta$, proving the final assertion.
\end{proof}

The executable certificate brackets the root with 120 bisections and records
both sides of the equation.  At $t=3\cdot10^{-6}$ and $m=6$, it treats both
the ideal $\eta=0$ envelope and the declared $\eta=10^{-3}$ collar.

\begin{theorem}[Conditional coherent-channel closure]
Let $q=0.002430277501841998$ be the Stage 25 weighted target.  There exists an
explicit local radius $r_*$, printed in the accompanying calibration, such
that
\[
 e^{\ell(r_*)}\,q_{\rm ref}(r_*)
 +q_{\rm coh}(2r_*,10^{-3})<q,
 \qquad r_*<0.011453785959974176.
\]
Here $q_{\rm ref}$ and $\ell$ are the certified local-reference complement and
comparison loss, while $q_{\rm coh}$ is the optimized finite-time bound above.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
All three functions are evaluated by the prior exact/certified modules.  The
calibration first brackets the crossing in the sharp nonlinear window and
then uses 120 bisections, moving into the strict feasible side.  The tests
independently verify the stationarity residual, local minimality, crossing,
strict budget, and radius inclusion.
\end{proof}

\begin{remark}[Logical scope]
The second theorem is conditional on collar coherence.  It proves neither the
probability of the coherence event nor the incoherent complement numerator.
It also does not identify the abstract $K+R$ split with the complete nonlinear
finite-volume kernel.  Those missing statements are exactly the target of the
next stage.
\end{remark}
